operationKey.description: Your key for this operation: make a new random one for each call (a UUID, for example), 16 to 128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -. The same key with the same content answers the first result without doing the work again; the same key with other content is REQUEST_CONFLICT. The key belongs to this session, and the result is kept for 24 hours.

role.description: This session's role as the user's request or instructions set it, in one line (for example the component or kind of work it owns). Write only a role the user gave; it grants no authority. Omit it to keep the role already written.
